scope: All 107 frozen approved artworks plus all 25 partial/missing image exceptions, exact-ID evidence consolidation and eight externally located object-source leads; research-only, not new native pixel verification
blocking_policies: The selected 107 are counted separately from the 101 historically recovered prayer-art subject approvals; never sum or equate those baselines.
The 25 exceptions overlap with the 383 catalogue and one approved item; sum 107+25 is review workload, not distinct painting count.
Existing B50 Commons licence claims do not certify the exact archived/selected image for app commercial reuse.
B53 SHA-in-archive preview validity is not a new full resolution byte check, visual art correctness or native edge QA.
An institutional catalogue page confirms object identity, NOT licensed museum photography or frameless reproduction.
Do not substitute distinct museum painting, engraving, detail crop or framed photograph.
No money, contact/permission requests or automatic production release.
